translations.idiomatic: Barsari was a veteran of many reigns, while Köke Temur was a younger man who had risen late, yet they were made coequal chancellors.

sentences.zh: 居兩月，即請南還視師。

translations.literal: After two months he requested to return south to oversee the armies.
translations.idiomatic: After two months he asked to return south to oversee the armies.

sentences.zh: 是時，中原雖無事，而江淮、川蜀皆非我所有。

translations.literal: At that time the Central Plains were tranquil, but Jianghuai and Chuan-Shu were no longer held by the dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Central Plains were tranquil, but Jianghuai and Sichuan were no longer in imperial hands.

sentences.zh: 皇太子累請出督師，而帝難之，乃詔封擴廓帖木兒河南王，俾總天下兵而代之行。

translations.literal: The heir apparent repeatedly asked to go out and supervise the armies, but the emperor found it difficult; he then issued an edict enfeoffing Köke Temur as Prince of Henan and ordered him to command all armies under Heaven in the heir apparent's stead.
translations.idiomatic: The heir apparent repeatedly asked to go out and command the armies, but the emperor hesitated; he then enfeoffed Köke Temur as Prince of Henan and ordered him to command all armies under Heaven in the heir apparent's stead.

sentences.zh: 擴廓帖木兒於是分省以自隨，官屬之盛，幾與朝廷等，而用孫翥、趙恆等為謀主。

translations.literal: Köke Temur thereupon took a branch secretariat with him; the splendor of his retinue nearly equaled the court's, and he made Sun Gao and Zhao Heng his chief advisers.
translations.idiomatic: Köke Temur took a branch secretariat with him; his retinue nearly rivaled the court in splendor, and he made Sun Gao and Zhao Heng his chief advisers.

sentences.zh: 二十六年二月，自京師還河南，欲廬墓以終喪。

translations.literal: In the second month of the twenty-sixth year he left the capital for Henan, wishing to build a mourning lodge at his father's tomb and complete the mourning period.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the twenty-sixth year (1366) he left the capital for Henan, intending to build a mourning lodge at his father's tomb and complete the mourning period.

sentences.zh: 左右咸以謂受命出師不可中止，乃復北渡，居懷慶，又移居彰德。

translations.literal: His attendants all said that having received orders to campaign he could not stop; he crossed north again, dwelt at Huaiqing, then moved to Zhangde.
translations.idiomatic: His attendants all said that having received orders to campaign he could not stop; he crossed north again, settled at Huaiqing, then moved to Zhangde.

sentences.zh: 初，李思齊與察罕帖木兒同起義師，齒位相等。

translations.literal: Earlier Li Siqi and Chaghan Temur had raised loyalist armies together, their rank and seniority equal.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Li Siqi and Chaghan Temur had raised loyalist armies together as equals in rank and seniority.

sentences.zh: 及是擴廓帖木兒總其兵，思齊心不能平。

translations.literal: Now that Köke Temur commanded his troops, Siqi's heart could not be at peace.
translations.idiomatic: Now that Köke Temur commanded his troops, Siqi could not accept it in his heart.

sentences.zh: 而張良弼首拒命，孔興、脫列伯等​​亦皆以功自恃，各懷異見，請別為一軍，莫肯統屬。

translations.literal: Zhang Liangbi was the first to refuse orders; Kong Xing, Tuoliebo, and others also relied on their merits, each harbored divergent views, asked to form separate armies, and would accept no unified command.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Liangbi was the first to refuse orders; Kong Xing, Tuoliebo, and others also relied on their merits, each harbored his own views, asked to form separate armies, and would accept no unified command.

sentences.zh: 釁隙既開，遂成仇敵。

translations.literal: Once enmity had opened between them, they became sworn foes.
translations.idiomatic: Once enmity had opened between them, they became sworn enemies.

sentences.zh: 擴廓帖木兒乃遣關保、虎林赤以兵西攻良弼於鹿台，而思齊亦與良弼合，兵連不能罷。

translations.literal: Köke Temur then dispatched Guan Bao and Hulinchi with troops west to attack Liangbi at Lutai, while Siqi also joined Liangbi; the fighting continued without cease.
translations.idiomatic: Köke Temur then sent Guan Bao and Hulinchi west to attack Zhang Liangbi at Lutai, while Li Siqi also joined Liangbi; the fighting continued without cease.

sentences.zh: 擴廓帖木兒始受命南征，而顧乃退居彰德，又惟務用兵陝西，天子之命置而不問，朝廷因疑其有異志。

translations.literal: Köke Temur had first received orders for the southern campaign, yet he withdrew to Zhangde and devoted himself solely to war in Shaanxi, setting the Son of Heaven's commands aside unanswered; the court therefore suspected him of disloyal intent.
translations.idiomatic: Köke Temur had first received orders for the southern campaign, yet he withdrew to Zhangde and devoted himself solely to war in Shaanxi, ignoring the emperor's commands; the court therefore suspected him of disloyal intent.

sentences.zh: 皇太子之奔太原也，欲用唐肅宗靈武故事，因而自立。

translations.literal: When the heir apparent fled to Taiyuan he wished to follow the Tang precedent of Emperor Suzong at Lingwu and thereby establish himself as ruler.
translations.idiomatic: When the heir apparent fled to Taiyuan he wished to follow the Tang precedent of Emperor Suzong at Lingwu and establish himself as ruler.

sentences.zh: 擴廓帖木兒與孛蘭奚等不從。

translations.literal: Köke Temur and Bolanxi and others would not comply.
translations.idiomatic: Köke Temur and Bolanxi and others would not comply.

sentences.zh: 及還京師，皇后奇氏傳旨，令擴廓帖木兒以重兵擁太子入城，欲脅帝禪之位。

translations.literal: On returning to the capital, Empress Qi transmitted an order instructing Köke Temur to enter the city with a heavy escort for the heir apparent, intending to coerce the emperor into abdication.
translations.idiomatic: On returning to the capital, Empress Qi transmitted an order instructing Köke Temur to enter the city with a heavy escort for the heir apparent, intending to force the emperor to abdicate.

sentences.zh: 擴廓帖木兒知其意，比至京城三十里，即散遣其軍。

translations.literal: Köke Temur understood their intent; when he was still thirty li from the capital he dispersed his army.
translations.idiomatic: Köke Temur understood their intent; when he was still thirty li from the capital he dispersed his army.

sentences.zh: 由是皇​​太子心銜之。

translations.literal: For this the heir apparent bore a grievance against him.
translations.idiomatic: For this the heir apparent bore a grievance against him.

sentences.zh: 及是，屢趣其出師江淮。

translations.literal: Now he repeatedly urged him to campaign in Jianghuai.
translations.idiomatic: Now he repeatedly urged him to campaign in Jianghuai.

sentences.zh: 擴廓帖木兒第遣弟脫因帖木兒及部將完哲、貊高以兵往山東。

translations.literal: Köke Temur only sent his younger brother Tuoyin Temur and the generals Wanzhe and Mo Gao with troops to Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Köke Temur only sent his younger brother Tuoyin Temur and the generals Wanzhe and Mo Gao with troops to Shandong.

sentences.zh: 而西兵互相勝負，終不解。

translations.literal: But the western armies traded victories and defeats back and forth and in the end could not be resolved.
translations.idiomatic: But the western armies traded victories back and forth and in the end could not be resolved.

sentences.zh: 帝又下詔和解之，顧乃戕殺詔使天下奴等，而跋扈之跡成矣。

translations.literal: The emperor again issued an edict to reconcile them, yet Köke Temur slaughtered the edict envoy Tianxia Nu and others, and his overbearing conduct was fully manifest.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor again issued an edict to reconcile them, yet Köke Temur slaughtered the edict envoy Tianxia Nu and others, and his overbearing conduct was fully manifest.

sentences.zh: 二十七年八月，帝乃下詔命皇太子親出總天下兵馬，而分命擴廓帖木兒以其兵自潼關以東，肅清江淮；

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the twenty-seventh year the emperor issued an edict ordering the heir apparent to go out in person and command all armies under Heaven, while assigning Köke Temur with his troops from east of Tong Pass to purge Jianghuai;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the twenty-seventh year (1367) the emperor ordered the heir apparent to go out in person and command all armies under Heaven, while assigning Köke Temur with his troops from east of Tong Pass to purge Jianghuai;

sentences.zh: 李思齊以其兵自鳳翔以西，進取川蜀；

translations.literal: Li Siqi with his troops from west of Fengxiang to advance into Chuan-Shu;
translations.idiomatic: Li Siqi with his troops from west of Fengxiang to advance into Sichuan;

sentences.zh: 禿魯以其兵與張良弼、孔興、脫列伯等​​取襄樊；

translations.literal: Tuolubu with his troops, together with Zhang Liangbi, Kong Xing, and Tuoliebo, to take Xiang and Fan;
translations.idiomatic: Tuolubu with his troops, together with Zhang Liangbi, Kong Xing, and Tuoliebo, to take Xiangyang and Fancheng;

sentences.zh: 王信以其兵固守山東信地。

translations.literal: Wang Xin with his troops to hold fast to his Shandong territories.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xin with his troops to hold fast to his Shandong territories.

sentences.zh: 然詔書雖下，皇太子亦竟止不行，而分兵之命，擴廓帖木兒終扞拒不肯受。

translations.literal: Yet though the edict was issued, the heir apparent in the end still did not go out, and Köke Temur to the end resisted and refused the order to divide his troops.
translations.idiomatic: Yet though the edict was issued, the heir apparent in the end still did not go out, and Köke Temur to the end resisted and refused the order to divide his troops.

sentences.zh: 於是貊高、關保等皆叛擴廓帖木兒。

translations.literal: Thereupon Mo Gao, Guan Bao, and others all rebelled against Köke Temur.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Mo Gao, Guan Bao, and others all rebelled against Köke Temur.

sentences.zh: 關保自察罕帖木兒起兵以來即為將，勇冠諸軍，功最高。

translations.literal: Guan Bao had served as a general from the time Chaghan Temur first raised his army; his bravery surpassed all others' and his achievements were highest.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Bao had served as a general from the time Chaghan Temur first raised his army; his bravery surpassed all others and his achievements were highest.

sentences.zh: 而貊高善論兵，尤為察罕帖木兒所信任。

translations.literal: Mo Gao was skilled at military discussion and was especially trusted by Chaghan Temur.
translations.idiomatic: Mo Gao was skilled at military discussion and was especially trusted by Chaghan Temur.

sentences.zh: 及是，兩人見擴廓帖木兒有不臣之心，故皆叛之，列其罪狀聞於朝，舉兵共攻之。

translations.literal: Now the two, seeing Köke Temur's disloyal intent, therefore both rebelled, set forth his crimes in reports to the court, and raised troops jointly to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: Now the two, seeing Köke Temur's disloyal intent, both rebelled, set forth his crimes in reports to the court, and raised troops jointly to attack him.

sentences.zh: 而皇太子用沙藍答兒、帖林沙、伯顏帖木兒、李國鳳等計，立撫軍院，總制天下軍馬，專備擴廓帖木兒。

translations.literal: The heir apparent adopted the plans of Shaladai'er, Tielinsha, Bayan Temur, Li Guofeng, and others, established the Pacification Army Commission to command all armies under Heaven, and devoted it solely to guarding against Köke Temur.
translations.idiomatic: The heir apparent adopted the plans of Shaladai'er, Tielinsha, Bayan Temur, Li Guofeng, and others, established the Pacification Army Commission to command all armies under Heaven, and devoted it solely to guarding against Köke Temur.

sentences.zh: 以貊高等能倡大義，賜號忠義功臣。

translations.literal: Because Mo Gao and others could uphold the righteous cause, they were granted the title Meritorious Ministers of Loyalty and Righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: Because Mo Gao and others had upheld the righteous cause, they were granted the title of meritorious ministers of loyalty and righteousness.

sentences.zh: 十月，詔落擴廓帖木兒太傅、中書左丞相，依前河南王，以汝州為食邑，與弟脫因帖木兒同居河南府，而以河南府為梁王食邑，從行官屬悉令還朝。

translations.literal: In the tenth month an edict removed Köke Temur's posts as Grand Mentor and left chancellor of the Central Secretariat; he remained Prince of Henan as before, with Ruzhou as his fief; he was to dwell in Henan Prefecture with his younger brother Tuoyin Temur, while Henan Prefecture was made the fief of the Prince of Liang; all his attending officials were ordered back to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month an edict removed Köke Temur's posts as grand mentor and left chancellor of the central secretariat; he remained Prince of Henan as before, with Ruzhou as his fief; he was to dwell in Henan Prefecture with his younger brother Tuoyin Temur, while Henan Prefecture was made the fief of the Prince of Liang; all his attending officials were ordered back to court.

sentences.zh: 凡擴廓帖木兒所總諸軍，在帳前者白鎖住、虎林赤領之，在河南者李克彝領之，在山東者也速領之，在山西者沙藍答兒領之，在河北者貊高領之。

translations.literal: All armies formerly under Köke Temur: those at headquarters Bai Suozhu and Hulinchi; in Henan Li Keyi; in Shandong Yesüder; in Shanxi Shaladai'er; in Hebei Mo Gao.
translations.idiomatic: All armies formerly under Köke Temur were reassigned: headquarters to Bai Suozhu and Hulinchi, Henan to Li Keyi, Shandong to Yesüder, Shanxi to Shaladai'er, and Hebei to Mo Gao.

sentences.zh: 擴廓帖木兒既受詔，即退軍屯澤州。

translations.literal: Once Köke Temur had received the edict, he withdrew his army to encamp at Zezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Once Köke Temur had received the edict, he withdrew his army to camp at Zezhou.

sentences.zh: 詔又命禿魯與李思齊、張良弼、孔興、脫列伯率兵東向，以正天討。

translations.literal: An edict also ordered Tuolubu together with Li Siqi, Zhang Liangbi, Kong Xing, and Tuoliebo to lead troops eastward to carry out Heaven's punishment.
translations.idiomatic: An edict also ordered Tuolubu together with Li Siqi, Zhang Liangbi, Kong Xing, and Tuoliebo to lead troops eastward to carry out Heaven's punishment.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，朝廷命左丞孫景益分省太原，關保以兵為之守。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year the court appointed Left Councillor Sun Jingyi to the Taiyuan branch secretariat, with Guan Bao's troops to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year (1368) the court appointed left councillor Sun Jingyi to the Taiyuan branch secretariat, with Guan Bao's troops to garrison it.

sentences.zh: 擴廓帖木兒即遣兵據太原，而盡殺朝廷所置官。

translations.literal: Köke Temur immediately sent troops to seize Taiyuan and killed all officials the court had installed.
translations.idiomatic: Köke Temur immediately sent troops to seize Taiyuan and killed all officials the court had installed.

sentences.zh: 皇太子乃命魏賽因不花及關保皆以兵與思齊、良弼諸軍夾攻澤州，而天子又下詔削奪擴廓帖木兒爵邑，令諸軍共誅之，其將士官吏效順者與免本罪，惟孫翥、趙恆罪在所不赦。

translations.literal: The heir apparent then ordered Wei Sayin Buhua and Guan Bao to join Siqi's and Liangbi's armies in a pincer attack on Zezhou, while the Son of Heaven again issued an edict stripping Köke Temur of his fief and titles and ordering all armies jointly to execute him; officers, soldiers, and officials who submitted would be pardoned their crimes, but Sun Gao and Zhao Heng alone were beyond pardon.
translations.idiomatic: The heir apparent then ordered Wei Sayin Buhua and Guan Bao to join Li Siqi's and Zhang Liangbi's armies in a pincer attack on Zezhou, while the emperor again stripped Köke Temur of his fief and titles and ordered all armies jointly to execute him; officers, soldiers, and officials who submitted would be pardoned, but Sun Gao and Zhao Heng alone were beyond pardon.

sentences.zh: 二月，擴廓帖木兒退守於平陽，而關保遂據澤、潞二州，以與貊高合。

translations.literal: In the second month Köke Temur fell back to defend Pingyang, while Guan Bao seized Ze and Lu prefectures and joined with Mo Gao.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Köke Temur fell back to defend Pingyang, while Guan Bao seized Ze and Lu prefectures and joined with Mo Gao.

sentences.zh: 時李思齊、張良弼、孔興、脫列伯與擴廓帖木兒相持既久，大明兵時已及河南，思齊、良弼皆遣使詣擴廓帖木兒，告以出師非本心，乃解兵大掠西歸。

translations.literal: By then Li Siqi, Zhang Liangbi, Kong Xing, and Tuoliebo had confronted Köke Temur for a long time; Great Ming forces had already reached Henan; Siqi and Liangbi both sent envoys to Köke Temur saying their campaigns had not been voluntary, then dismissed their armies, plundered heavily, and marched west in retreat.
translations.idiomatic: By then Li Siqi, Zhang Liangbi, Kong Xing, and Tuoliebo had confronted Köke Temur for a long time; Great Ming forces had already reached Henan; Li Siqi and Zhang Liangbi both sent envoys to Köke Temur saying their campaigns had not been voluntary, then dismissed their armies, plundered heavily, and marched west in retreat.

sentences.zh: 七月，貊高、關保進攻平陽。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Mo Gao and Guan Bao advanced to attack Pingyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Mo Gao and Guan Bao advanced to attack Pingyang.

sentences.zh: 當是時，擴廓帖木兒氣稍沮，而關保、貊高勢甚振，數請戰，擴廓帖木兒不應，或師出即復退。

translations.literal: At that time Köke Temur's morale was somewhat broken, while Guan Bao and Mo Gao were in high spirits; they repeatedly asked for battle, but Köke Temur would not respond, or if he marched out he at once withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Köke Temur's morale was somewhat broken, while Guan Bao and Mo Gao were in high spirits; they repeatedly asked for battle, but Köke Temur would not respond, or if he marched out he at once withdrew.

sentences.zh: 一日，諜知貊高分軍掠祁縣，即夜出師薄其營掩擊之，大敗其眾，貊高、關保皆就擒。

translations.literal: One day spies reported that Mo Gao had divided his army to plunder Qi County; Köke Temur marched out that night, pressed close to their camp, and struck by surprise; he routed their force utterly, and Mo Gao and Guan Bao were both captured.
translations.idiomatic: One day spies reported that Mo Gao had divided his army to plunder Qi County; Köke Temur marched out that night, pressed close to their camp, and struck by surprise; he routed their force utterly, and Mo Gao and Guan Bao were both captured.

sentences.zh: 朝廷聞之，遽罷撫軍院，而帖林沙、伯顏帖木兒、李國鳳等以誤國皆受黜。

translations.literal: When the court heard this it hastily abolished the Pacification Army Commission, while Tielinsha, Bayan Temur, Li Guofeng, and others were all dismissed for having harmed the state.
translations.idiomatic: When the court heard this it hastily abolished the Pacification Army Commission, while Tielinsha, Bayan Temur, Li Guofeng, and others were all dismissed for having harmed the state.

sentences.zh: 既而擴廓帖木兒上疏自陳其情悃，帝尋亦悔悟，下詔滌其前非。

translations.literal: Köke Temur then submitted a memorial stating his loyal intent in full; the emperor soon also came to regret and issued an edict cleansing his former faults.
translations.idiomatic: Köke Temur then submitted a memorial stating his loyal intent in full; the emperor soon came to regret and issued an edict cleansing his former faults.

sentences.zh: 於是大明兵已定山東及河、洛，中原俱不守。

translations.literal: By then Great Ming troops had already secured Shandong and the He-Luo region; the Central Plains were all abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: By then Great Ming troops had already secured Shandong and the He-Luo region; the Central Plains were all abandoned.

sentences.zh: 閏七月，帝乃下詔，復命擴廓帖木兒仍前河南王、太傅、中書左丞相，孫翥、趙恆並復舊職，以兵從河北南討，也速以兵趨山東，禿魯兵出潼關，李思齊兵出七盤、金、商，以圖复汴、洛。

translations.literal: In the intercalary seventh month the emperor issued an edict restoring Köke Temur to his former titles as Prince of Henan, Grand Mentor, and left chancellor of the Central Secretariat, restoring Sun Gao and Zhao Heng to their former posts, ordering him with troops to campaign south from Hebei, Yesüder with troops toward Shandong, Tuolubu's army out through Tong Pass, Li Siqi's army out through Qipan, Jin, and Shang, to recover Bian and Luo.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary seventh month the emperor issued an edict restoring Köke Temur to his former titles as Prince of Henan, grand mentor, and left chancellor of the central secretariat, restoring Sun Gao and Zhao Heng to their former posts, ordering him with troops to campaign south from Hebei, Yesüder toward Shandong, Tuolubu's army out through Tong Pass, Li Siqi's army out through Qipan, Jin, and Shang, to recover Bianliang and Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 未幾，也速兵遂潰，禿魯、思齊兵亦未嘗出，而擴廓帖木兒又自平陽退守太原，不復敢南向，事已不可為矣。

translations.literal: Before long Yesüder's army collapsed; Tuolubu and Siqi's troops never marched out either; Köke Temur again fell back from Pingyang to defend Taiyuan and no longer dared march south—the affair was already beyond recovery.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Yesüder's army collapsed; Tuolubu and Li Siqi's troops never marched out either; Köke Temur again fell back from Pingyang to defend Taiyuan and no longer dared march south—the affair was already beyond recovery.

sentences.zh: 已而大明兵迫京城，帝北奔，國遂以亡。

translations.literal: Before long Great Ming troops pressed the capital; the emperor fled north, and the state was thus lost.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Great Ming troops pressed the capital; the emperor fled north, and the state was thus lost.

sentences.zh: 及大明兵至太原，擴廓帖木兒即棄城遁，領其餘眾西奔於甘肅。

translations.literal: When Great Ming troops reached Taiyuan, Köke Temur at once abandoned the city and fled, leading his remaining forces west into Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: When Great Ming troops reached Taiyuan, Köke Temur at once abandoned the city and fled, leading his remaining forces west into Gansu.
